caption:
There is a road in India that ends at the Chinese border, and we drive our group right up to it.

Bumla Pass sits in western Arunachal, and the Indian Army takes you to the line itself. Getting there means crossing Sela Pass at 13,476 feet and passing Jaswant Garh, where one soldier held off an army in 1962.

Then it keeps going. Tawang Monastery, India's largest. Kaziranga's one-horned rhinos. Dawki, where the river is so clear the boats look like they are floating on air. Mawlynnong, Asia's cleanest village. The Living Root Bridge at Riwai.

11 days. 3 states. Rs 81,000 per person, Pune flight included, Inner Line Permit included, 5% GST included. No TCS, no visa, because it is all domestic.

The honest part: Arunachal hotels are non-star, the drives run 6 to 8 hours on mountain roads, and this one is built for 25 to 55. Not for your parents. We would rather say that now than at the airport.

We run this twice a year. The second batch leaves 21 October.
